'''Pepys''' is a NPC female researcher, found teaching in Rabelle College classroom about Royan culture with '''[[Stanik]]'''. She can also be found help answer another student, [[Sloan]], about Roya algorithms. 

{{color|help|Players can attend her class at <nowiki>12:00-18:00</nowiki> in the Rabelle College Classroom.}}

==Locations==

==Idle==
:'''Pepys:''' The calender used by the Roya shares similarities with the solar calender.
:'''Pepys:''' But the "sun" in their calender isn't the one in the sky. It's actually the Reactor Drive.
:'''Pepys:''' The Sacred Reactor Calender has been used by the Roya for generations, with the Solisylum calculating and publishing a new version each year.
:'''Pepys:''' Now, I'll hand it over to Stanik to walk us through how the calender has changed over the years...
:'''Stanik:''' Before we begin this discussion, there's something I need to clarify.
:'''Stanik:''' Roya customs devloped gradually around our mission here at Startorch.
:'''Stanik:''' The sun gives us day, night, and seasons. The Void Storms eat away at the world.
:'''Stanik:''' Shepherds help the Exoswarm migrate, and in doing so, gather data on the Reactor Drive and the Void Storms for the Solisylum.
:'''Stanik:''' In that way, you can say the calender is a custom that grew directly from our mission to tend to the Exoswarm and monitor Void Storms.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;Sit Down
:'''Rover:''' I know this class...
:{{DIcon}} (Pay close attention.)
::'''Stanik:''' Before we begin this discussion, there's something I need to clarify.
::'''Stanik:''' Roya customs devloped gradually around our mission here at Startorch.
::'''Stanik:''' The sun gives us day, night, and seasons. The Void Storms eat away at the world.
::'''Stanik:''' Shepherds help the Exoswarm migrate, and in doing so, gather data on the Reactor Drive and the Void Storms for the Solisylum.
::'''Stanik:''' In that way, you can say the calender is a custom that grew directly from our mission to tend to the Exoswarm and monitor Void Storms.
:{{DIcon}} (Doze off.)
;(Time will be <nowiki>18:00</nowiki> afterwards)
----
;Afternoon
:'''Sloan:''' Professor Pepys, the textbook doesn't seem to cover the Reactor Drive algorithms the Solisylum uses.
:'''Pepys:''' That's outside the scope of this Royan Culture course. But if you're curious, you could always take the Solis Lens Array Engineering elective.
:'''Pepys:''' They get into the nitty-gritty of the Drive's operations. The Academy and the Solisylum use different algorithms, but they're both trying to solve the same puzzle.
:'''Pepys:''' What a coincidence, I happened to have a physical copy of "Solis Method: An Introduction" with me...
:'''Sloan:''' That thing's a brick! Are you sure this is just an introduction?
:'''Pepys:''' Yes, it is. Royan calculation methods are really complex and precise.
:'''Pepys:''' If you're interested, you could ask Stanik, or even visit the Roya settlements to learn more.
{{Dialogue End}}
